# Audit finding M4 fixture — Win32_Battery fields.
#
# SYNTHETIC, LABELED AS SUCH: no real Windows machine is available in the
# sandbox, so no genuine `Get-CimInstance Win32_Battery` (or in-process WMI
# query) output could be captured here. The values follow the documented
# Win32_Battery property semantics on Microsoft Learn (retrieved 2026-11-20):
#   - DesignCapacity / FullChargeCapacity: milliwatt-hours (0 = unsupported)
#   - DesignVoltage: millivolts
#   - EstimatedChargeRemaining: percent
#   - BatteryStatus: ENUMERATED code, not a bitfield
#     (1 discharging, 2 on AC not necessarily charging, 3 fully charged,
#      6-9 charging variants, 11 partially charged)
# The values are realistic magnitudes for a 14" laptop pack.
DesignCapacity: 60000
FullChargeCapacity: 48000
DesignVoltage: 11400
EstimatedChargeRemaining: 65
BatteryStatus: 2
